Hi Dana,

Thanks for sending the numbers so quickly. Two videos in October works for us, and the fee you proposed fits our budget.

Let me know which dates suit you best.
Robin

Hi Marco,

Thanks for sending the draft. The hook is strong and the pacing works well for a short video.

One change: please mention the free plan before the link.

Let me know which dates suit you best.

Hey Tomas!

Great news, the brief is approved and you can start filming whenever you are ready. 🎉

Let me know which dates suit you best!
Quick update on the spring campaign — we are moving the launch by one week, so every go-live date shifts by seven days. Nothing else changes on your side.

Last month a creator turned down our offer, and it was the most useful no of the year.

She showed us exactly where our brief was vague.

What is the best feedback you ever got from a no?

Three things I check before any paid collaboration:
- the last ten videos, not the best ten
- who comments, not how many
- whether the audience asks real questions

What would you add?
